deductions.item: Summary for the approver (rubric: short, roughly 120 words or fewer)
deductions.quote: please also confirm the trip approval and dates (12 to 15 October) that the claimant states on the form, since the documents contain no separate record of them. The form total of GBP 1,415.74 matches the line items, every receipt R01 to R11 is matched to a line, and the claim was submitted on 26 October, within the 30-day limit of clause 2.1.
deductions.reason: Summary runs to about 169 words, well over the roughly 120-word limit, padded with routine checks and a request the key does not support (the key takes the approved trip dates 12 to 15 October from the claim as given); clearly bloated, so 5 instead of 10.
